lead.event: DOOH announces corporate actions including an acquisition of INET shares
lead.headline: DOOH plans Rp2 trillion acquisition of 29.88% of INET
lead.blurb: Era Media Sejahtera plans the purchase through Cakrawala Nexus Investama, covering 6.68 billion Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima shares at Rp300 each. Funding would come from a Rp2 trillion drawdown of new controller Sinergi Internasional Investama’s Rp5 trillion, 10-year shareholder loan facility, bearing 7.50% annual interest. DOOH also proposes a rights issue of up to 154.77 billion shares with Series II warrants. Shareholders vote on the actions at an EGM on 9 November, which will also consider a company name change and board restructuring.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The EGM will also consider a company name change and board restructuring.

earnings_guidance.event: JPFA, CPIN, MAIN and WMPP report Q3 growth
earnings_guidance.headline: JPFA, CPIN, MAIN and WMPP report Q3 growth, with CPIN profit up 54%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Japfa Comfeed's revenue rose 26% to Rp54.52 trillion and net profit grew 34%; Charoen Pokphand Indonesia's revenue rose 18.9% and net profit reached Rp5.18 trillion. Malindo Feedmill's net profit grew 24.89%, while Widodo Makmur Perkasa returned to profit at Rp103.10 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Permata reports lower Q3 net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: BNLI reports nine-month net profit down 10.9% to Rp2.57 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Permata's net interest and sharia income fell 2.49% to Rp7.38 trillion, while gains on sales of investment securities dropped 59.25%. Loans rose 10.1% to Rp172.9 trillion, and gross NPL improved to 2.1% from 2.2%.

earnings_guidance.event: Palm-oil issuers report earnings growth as CGS names TAPG its top pick
earnings_guidance.headline: Palm-oil issuers post 35.7% profit growth as CGS names TAPG top pick
earnings_guidance.blurb: CGS International analyst Rut Yesika Simak maintained an overweight rating on the sector. The broker cites Triputra Agro Persada’s low cash costs and plantation productivity, with projected 2027 ROE of 35.8% and an 8.5% dividend yield assuming a 75% payout ratio.

earnings_guidance.event: ACES reports nine-month results and lags its 2026 store-expansion target
earnings_guidance.headline: ACES reports 9M26 profit up 25.7% as store openings trail target
earnings_guidance.blurb: By August, Aspirasi Hidup Indonesia had opened 15 AZKO and 16 NEKA stores, versus 2026 targets of 25-30 and 40-50. Nine-month sales rose 8.3% to Rp6.9 trillion, while capex of Rp144.8 billion represented about 32%-36% of its annual budget, suggesting some expansion could shift to 2027.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

market_structure_policy.event: IDX suspends MKNT trading after a steep share-price surge
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX suspends MKNT after 3,100% share-price rise
market_structure_policy.blurb: Mitra Komunikasi Nusantara shares rose for 14 consecutive trading days, from Rp1 to a last recorded Rp32, hitting the upper price limit. The suspension covers the Regular and Cash Markets from the pre-opening session and remains in place until a further exchange announcement. The IDX said the halt was a cooling-down measure to protect investors and give them time to make considered decisions.

market_structure_policy.event: IHSG bank weights rise after HSC-stock exclusion
market_structure_policy.headline: HSC-stock exclusion lifts BBCA, BBRI and BMRI to about 25.4% of IHSG
market_structure_policy.blurb: The capped free-float-adjusted market-cap method assigns 9% each to Bank Central Asia and Bank Rakyat Indonesia. Bank Mandiri’s weight rose from 5.9% to 7.4%, while Telkom Indonesia’s increased from 3.6% to 4.6%; analysts warned the change makes IHSG more sensitive to banking-sector sentiment.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

macro_flows.event: MSCI reclassification consultation drives Indonesian market outflows and prompts exchange response
macro_flows.headline: MSCI consultation puts $8-11 billion in foreign funds at risk
macro_flows.blurb: Mirae Asset Sekuritas estimated that $8-11 billion in foreign funds could leave Indonesia because of the reclassification risk. OJK is pushing the Indonesia Stock Exchange to strengthen shareholding transparency, improve free-float quality and refine its shareholding concentration mechanism and IHSG evaluation criteria.
macro_flows.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

deals_control.event: Bakrie Kalila Investment sells ENRG shares
deals_control.headline: ENRG shareholder Bakrie Kalila sells shares for Rp312.66 billion
deals_control.blurb: Energi Mega Persada shareholder Bakrie Kalila's reported sale figures differ on the quantity and timing. One report says its holding stood at 6.44% after a further 5 million shares were sold on 3 November, while Syailendra Bakrie's Shima Global Kapital sold 14 million shares and retained 11.65%.

deals_control.event: Takjub Finansial Teknologi sells a 9% stake in BNBA
deals_control.headline: Takjub Finansial sells 9% stake in BNBA
deals_control.blurb: It sold 304.92 million shares at Rp777 apiece on 2 November for about Rp236.92 billion. Its ownership fell from 33.45% to 24.45%, and it said it is not BNBA’s controlling shareholder and does not control the bank. The sale was reported to OJK on 5 November, according to an IDX disclosure.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: ANDA launches its IPO to fund operations and repay bank debt
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: Andalan Artha Primanusa launches IPO targeting Rp316.76 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Andalan Artha Primanusa is offering up to 1.67 billion new shares at Rp158–Rp189 each, equal to 25.10% of post-IPO capital. It will use 34.94% of net proceeds to repay loans, including about Rp65 billion to Mandiri and Rp42 billion to BNI.
